LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_HardyLabor.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] can take hardship, and will keep at unpleasant work.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FieldGleaner.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] is used to picking through edges and waste ground for anything edible.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_DisasterHerder.degre: [PAWN_nameDef] is good with animals. Even frightened livestock will come close to [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_WellBearer.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] can take a lot of weight without minding the load.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_MoldSifter.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] can tell which grain can still be cooked.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_GranaryCarpenter.deg: [PAWN_nameDef] is handy with roofs and wooden frames.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_RagTailor.degreeData: [PAWN_nameDef] is good at stitching rags and old felt into something usable.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_HerbReader.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] knows which herbs still bring a fever down, and can be trusted with a bandage.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_NightFugitive.degree: [PAWN_nameDef] prefers to move at night, and doesn't stumble much in the dark.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_SnowGuide.degreeData: [PAWN_nameDef] remembers old trail markers and tracks buried in snow.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_DustBearer.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] will carry grain and water all the way to the next camp, and rarely puts the load down.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_CampWatcher.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't panic easily. When the camp is in chaos, [PAWN_pronoun] can still keep a clear head.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_AlmsSpeaker.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] has a way with words. Even hard news comes out in a way people will listen to.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_JunkAppraiser.degree: [PAWN_nameDef] can tell what a sack of old goods is still worth, and is sharp in a trade.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_GrainMediator.degree: [PAWN_nameDef] steps in before a crowd starts grabbing, and can keep a situation from falling apart.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_WoundTender.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] has a steady hand with wounds, and smell or crying rarely stops [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_EggKeeper.degreeData: [PAWN_nameDef] puts the young first. If a child nearby goes hungry or falls ill, [PAWN_pronoun] takes it hard.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_LeanHunger.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] is used to splitting one meal into two, and can keep going on an empty stomach.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FinePaws.degreeDatas: [PAWN_nameDef] has a sure hand with fine work like mending sacks and threading needles.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_PathScout.degreeData: [PAWN_nameDef] notices movement early and checks the path before stepping.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_ColumnLead.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] lines people up before moving. Who walks first and who watches the young is for [PAWN_pronoun] to decide.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_ReliefCook.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] can turn a little grain into a hot meal that can still be shared.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FamineHunter.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] likes to pin prey up close, and moves quietly on the approach.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_HungerRage.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] sees food and the eyes go red. The emptier the stomach, the harder it is to keep still.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FoodSnatcher.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] can hardly watch food pass by. When hungry, the paws go to the sack first.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_PlagueDread.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] is especially afraid of plague. Being sick, or seeing someone nearby fall ill, makes [PAWN_pronoun] uneasy.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_NightTerrors.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] sleeps lightly and wakes at small sounds. Tiredness only makes the panic worse.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FamineSloth.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] is a little lazy, and will rest if there's a chance to rest.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_GrainGreed.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] can't stop eating while food is in reach, and hunger hits hard.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_Distrustful.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] has a hard time trusting anyone. Even kindness often looks like a trap to [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_WeakFlesh.degreeData: [PAWN_nameDef] is frail, and doesn't take knocks well.
[PAWN_nameDef] has a weak gut, and gets hungry again soon after a meal.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_Chillblood.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] hates the cold. When the wind picks up, [PAWN_pronoun] suffers for it.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FamineGloom.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] has a hard time believing anything good is coming, and cracks more easily under pressure.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_WailingYoung.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] is still small, and cries easily when hungry or cold.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_BitingYoung.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] hasn't learned to hide hunger. Near food, or when grabbed, biting follows.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_AlmsHate.degreeDatas: [PAWN_nameDef] treats charity as a humiliation, and won't bow to give thanks after taking what's offered.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_GrudgeKeeper.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] remembers who shut a gate and who took what was needed. The next meeting starts with the old grudge.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_PlagueSurvivor.degre: [PAWN_nameDef] survived plague once. Illness is easier to endure now, but tiredness comes more quickly.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_GrainSneak.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't show what is really wanted, and moves quietly when closing in.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_SiegeDigger.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] is good with a shovel, especially digging ways out and trenches.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_GranaryBreaker.degre: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't mind a close fight. The fists are ready before the sentence is finished.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_AilingMother.degreeD: [PAWN_nameDef] puts the children first. If a child is hungry or sick, [PAWN_pronoun] unravels.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_FamilyThief.degreeDa: [PAWN_nameDef] puts kin above rules. If the young of the den go hungry or fall ill, [PAWN_pronoun] can't sit still.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_QuarantineGuard.degr: [PAWN_nameDef] is hard to get close to, and keeps people apart with a firm hand and few words.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_WrongKin.degreeDatas: [PAWN_nameDef] will take a strange door for home, and takes it hard when that guess is wrong.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_CrowdChild.degreeDat: [PAWN_nameDef] is more at ease in a crowd, and talks poorly when left alone.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Trait_WildHole.degreeDatas: [PAWN_nameDef] looks first for cover, then for anything edible. Waste ground feels safer to [PAWN_objective] than a storehouse.
